title: The Vanity of Restraint

questions.question: What did the Preacher test his heart with?
questions.explanation: Ecclesiastes 2:1 (ESV): "I said in my heart, 'Come now, I will test you with pleasure; enjoy yourself.'"

questions.question: What did the Preacher say of laughter?
questions.explanation: Ecclesiastes 2:2 (ESV): "I said of laughter, 'It is mad,'"

questions.question: Did the Preacher deny himself anything his eyes desired?
questions.explanation: Ecclesiastes 2:10 (ESV): "And whatever my eyes desired I did not keep from them."

questions.question: What happens to the wise man and the fool alike?
questions.explanation: Ecclesiastes 2:16 (ESV): "How the wise dies just like the fool!"

questions.question: Who gives wisdom, knowledge, and joy?
questions.explanation: Ecclesiastes 2:26 (ESV): "For to the one who pleases him God has given wisdom and knowledge and joy,"

questions.question: I searched with my heart how to cheer my body with what?
questions.explanation: Ecclesiastes 2:3 (ESV): "I searched with my heart how to cheer my body with wine—"

questions.question: What did the Preacher build for himself?
questions.explanation: Ecclesiastes 2:4 (ESV): "I built houses and planted vineyards for myself."

questions.question: Wisdom excels folly as what excels darkness?
questions.explanation: Ecclesiastes 2:13 (ESV): "Then I saw that there is more gain in wisdom than in folly, as there is more gain in light than in darkness."

questions.question: Why did the Preacher hate life?
options: Work under the sun was grievous
questions.correctAnswer: Work under the sun was grievous
questions.explanation: Ecclesiastes 2:17 (ESV): "So I hated life, because what is done under the sun was grievous to me,"

questions.question: What does the Preacher say about his toil?
options: He must leave it to the man after him
questions.correctAnswer: He must leave it to the man after him
questions.explanation: Ecclesiastes 2:18 (ESV): "I hated all my toil in which I toil under the sun, seeing that I must leave it to the man who will come after me,"

questions.question: I bought male and female slaves, and had slaves who were what?
questions.explanation: Ecclesiastes 2:7 (ESV): "I bought male and female slaves, and had slaves who were born in my house."

questions.question: I gathered for myself silver and gold and the treasure of whom?
questions.explanation: Ecclesiastes 2:8 (ESV): "I also gathered for myself silver and gold and the treasure of kings and provinces."

questions.question: The wise man has his eyes in his head, but the fool walks in what?
questions.explanation: Ecclesiastes 2:14 (ESV): "The wise man has his eyes in his head, but the fool walks in darkness."

questions.question: For what has a man for all his toil and striving of heart? Even at night his heart does not what?
questions.explanation: Ecclesiastes 2:23 (ESV): "even at night his heart does not rest. This also is vanity."

questions.question: Is there nothing better for a person than to eat and drink and find enjoyment in his toil? This also is from where?
questions.explanation: Ecclesiastes 2:24 (ESV): "This also, I saw, is from the hand of God,"

key_verse_text: Then I considered all that my hands had done and the toil I had expended in doing it, and behold, all was vanity and a striving after wind, and there was nothing to be gained under the sun.
